newsitem.title: USA: ADC comfortable with $0.21 EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: ADC comfortable with $0.21 EPS estimate.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc sees the company's fiscal second-quarter earnings in line with analysts' estimates of $0.21 a share, its chief financial officer said on Monday.

"I'm comfortable with that," Robert Switz told Reuters, referring to the $0.21-a-share consenus estimate of 13 analysts surveyed by First Call. The range of their forecasts for the second quarter ended April 30 is $0.21 to $0.22.

Switz said the Minnetonka, Minnesota-based telecommunications equipment company still expected to post second-quarter revenues of about $279 million and about $536 million for the first six months of its fiscal year. The company released revenue estimates earlier this month.

The second-quarter revenue estimate represents a 45 percent increase over last year's $193 million and includes contributions of about $30 million from acquisitions made since April 30, 1996. The estimate for the first six months represents a 51 percent increase from last year's $356 million and includes about $70 million from acquisitions.
Switz, in Chicago for a conference, said almost all of the company's businesses, including video, broadband connection and wireless communications, were showing solid growth.
He said overall revenue growth from the company's ongoing businesses was about 30 percent, and he said he expected that pace to continue.

"We really see ourselves having the ability for the foreseeable future to continue to generate 30 percent from our core businesses and something above that from acquisitions and new...products," Switz said.
ADC will report final second-quarter results on May 27.
